newLayers.name: Standalone Master, Web UI and REST Submission
newLayers.description: The state kept by the standalone Master (worker, driver and executor descriptions and states), its pluggable recovery persistence engines (file system, RocksDB, ZooKeeper) and leader election, the master web UI pages, and the REST protocol and client/server used to submit applications to the standalone cluster.

appendDesc.RPC and Security: Also covers HadoopDelegationTokenManager, which obtains and renews Hadoop delegation tokens.

tour.title: Standalone Master recovery: persistence engines and leader election
tour.description: PersistenceEngine stores applications, drivers and workers so a new Master can rebuild its state. FileSystemPersistenceEngine, RocksDBPersistenceEngine and ZooKeeperPersistenceEngine are the implementations, created through RecoveryModeFactory. ZooKeeperLeaderElectionAgent decides which Master is the leader and reports changes through LeaderElectionAgent.
